description: Unified batch availability for picker / batch-to-batch transfer. Part of the Availability APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

isVariant.description: Is variant query parameter. Default: false. Optional.

noStock.description: No stock query parameter. Default: false. Optional.

warehouseUniqueName.description: Warehouse unique name query parameter. Optional.

excludeBatchUniqueName.description: Exclude batch unique name query parameter. Optional.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: expiryDate. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc. Optional.
